description: Joe is all about Service. After decades of successfully serving the community in private business, Joe now wants to bring his skillset to serve the community in public office. Serving the public should be exactly that: Serving Others. As a public servant, Joe plans to transcend politics and solely focus on working with all his colleagues in the state senate to fix L.A.’s and California issues that affect: your safety, your job, your taxes, your family and your environment. Joe promises to be “Your Employee” and work for You; not the other way around.
